evals.name: delegate-to-glm
evals.prompt: このリポジトリの失敗してるテストを GLM-5.2 に直させて、何をどう直したか結果を見せて。
evals.expected_output: Claude stages an isolated sandbox copy, writes the task to a prompt file, runs scripts/acp_run.py --agent opencode --model opencode-go/glm-5.2 against the sandbox, then reviews result.json + git diff — never editing the live repo itself.

evals.name: compare-two-models
evals.prompt: この関数のリファクタを Qwen3.7 Max と DeepSeek V4 Pro の両方にやらせて、出力の違いを比較したい。
evals.expected_output: Two sandboxed acp_run.py runs with --model opencode-go/qwen3.7-max and opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro in separate clones; then a diff/comparison of the two outputs, with model_verified confirmed for each.

evals.name: second-opinion-review
evals.prompt: opencode 経由で別ベンダーのモデルに、いま書いたこの変更のレビューを頼みたい。
evals.expected_output: Resolves opencode (local or npx), runs it via ACP in a sandbox to review the change, returns the external model's feedback. Uses the bundled client; does not hand-roll an ACP handshake.
